headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 15, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, with Seiya Suzuki leading the Cubs' offense. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins, while the Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Boston Red Sox 8-4. The Chicago White Sox had a successful day, taking down the Detroit Tigers in both a 9-5 and a 4-3 victory.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Vladimir Guerrero Jr. being placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. Other players affected include Abner Uribe, Colt Emerson, Davis Martin, Matt Chapman, Trevor McDonald, Garrett Whitlock, and James Outman.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox, while the Kansas City Royals traded for Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with Seiya Suzuki leading the Cubs' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Matthew Liberatore pitched 5.1 innings for the Cardinals, striking out 6 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow win over the Miami Marlins with a strong pitching performance from Chase Burns, who pitched 7.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a double that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox in their latest matchup. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Bubba Chandler earned the win with 5 strong innings on the mound.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by a dominant performance from their offense. Miguel Vargas led the charge with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Randal Grichuk, Andrew Benintendi, Tristan Peters, and Eduardo Valencia all made notable contributions in the game.

top_news.title: **Vladimir Guerrero Jr. Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox on August 12, 2026, as part of a trade. The deal is tied to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
